title: Story Settings
landsLaterBody: This tab isn't built yet. Nothing here is configurable.
unavailableBody: Something went wrong loading this device's story list. Go back and try again.
uninitialized: This story has no settings yet
uninitializedBody: Settings are written when a story finishes setup. Finish the wizard for this story, or reset its settings to defaults.

save.failed: Couldn't save your changes. They're still here — try again.
save.stale: Saved, but this screen is out of date. Reload to see the current values.
save.unsavedBody: You have unsaved changes on this screen. Save them, discard them, or stay here.

missingStory: This story could not be loaded.

swap.title: Change embedding model
swap.pickBody: Pick a model to switch this story to. The current model can't be selected.
swap.reindexHint: Rebuilds every vector under the new model. Crash-safe; resumable.
swap.keepHint: Stay on the current model. Nothing changes.
swap.optionsBody: Choose how to proceed with this switch.
swap.relabelHint: Update the recorded model without rebuilding any vectors.
swap.relabelDisclaimer: This is your assertion that the underlying model is unchanged. If it differs, retrieval quality degrades silently.
swap.resumeBody: Switching this story to {{model}} was interrupted, likely by a crash or force-quit. Resume to pick up where it left off, or cancel to keep this story on its current model.

reindexConfirm.title: Re-index this story?
reindexConfirm.body_one: Re-embeds all {{count}} entry in this story with {{model}}. Nothing is deleted — each embedding is replaced as it is rebuilt.
reindexConfirm.body_other: Re-embeds all {{count}} entries in this story with {{model}}. Nothing is deleted — each embedding is replaced as it is rebuilt.
reindexConfirm.bodyUnknownCount: Re-embeds every entry in this story with {{model}}. Nothing is deleted — each embedding is replaced as it is rebuilt.
reindexConfirm.cancelSemantics: You can cancel while it runs. Cancelling keeps the entries already rebuilt and queues the rest.

memory.heading: Memory

reason.modelMissing: The current embedding model is missing or was removed.

memory.swapPending: A switch is already pending for this story.
memory.busy: An embedder operation is already running for this story.
memory.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
memory.relabelBlocked: Can't relabel while a switch is in progress.
memory.swapPendingBody: Switching this story to {{model}} was interrupted. Nothing is being embedded until you resume or cancel.
